review_notes: I read the whole file and grepped Mathlib for uses of its simp lemmas: index_zmultiples, Nat.card_zpowers / Nat.card_zmultiples, finite_zpowers and infinite_zpowers. The simp lemmas all rewrite toward simpler forms (natAbs, orderOf, IsOfFinOrder), and I found no loop. finite_zpowers and infinite_zpowers agree with each other, and infinite_zpowers is proved by rewriting through finite_zpowers. Fintype.card_zpowers is deliberately not simp, and its docstring points to Nat.card_zpowers instead. The `_symm_apply` lemmas are all rfl-style unfoldings of Equiv definitions, so I did not recommend making them simp. I found no concrete simp-set problem. I did not run Lean, so I could not check for simp-set interactions that only show up at compile time.
